Question 11(c) [4 marks]: Explain how the performance objectives impact operations processes for this business.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
A luxury clothing brand for made-to-measure men's suits has set performance objectives to increase customisation and quality.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Clearly relates cause and effect of performance objectives (customisation and quality) impact operations processes
3 marks: Relates cause and effect of performance objectives (customisation and quality) impact operations processes
2 marks: Sketches in general terms how performance objectives impact operations
1 marks: Makes a relevant statement about operations

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
The performance objectives of customisation and quality significantly impact the operations processes of the luxury suit business. Firstly, the objective of customisation (the ability to meet a wide variety of customer preferences when producing suits) will impact the processes of variety and visibility: the customers of bespoke, tailor-made suits will have autonomy over the inputs such as fabrics, colours and design of the suit, as well as customer contact seeing the transformation processes including measurements and the suit workshop. Secondly, the objective of quality will inevitably influence the processes, most notably the inputs such as materials, but also the monitoring, control and improvement aspects of the operations process. To ensure a high-quality finish, operations will ensure tight quality controls; considering this, lead times will be longer, however this allows for the necessary processes to take place to guarantee customer satisfaction.

ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Performance objectives: quality, speed, dependability, flexibility, customisation, cost. Operations processes: inputs, transformation processes, outputs.
